scripts.dev: npm run build -w @trendlix/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trendlix/shared && npm run build -w @trendlix/api && npm run build -w @trendlix/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @trendlix/api && npm run test -w @trendlix/web
